description: This file defines data structures, enums, and classes related to Gemini model operations, including file states, content generation, image and video generation requests and responses, and long-running operation metadata.

classes.name: GeminiFilesState
classes.description: Enumeration of possible states for Gemini files.

classes.name: GeminiFilesSource
classes.description: Enumeration of possible sources for Gemini files.

classes.name: GeminiCreateFilesResponseObject
classes.description: TypedDict representing the response object for Gemini file creation.

classes.name: BidiGenerateContentTranscription
classes.description: TypedDict for transcriptions of audio content.

classes.name: BidiGenerateContentServerContent
classes.description: TypedDict for server content during content generation, with optional fields.

classes.name: BidiGenerateContentServerMessage
classes.description: TypedDict for server messages during content generation, with optional fields.

classes.name: BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput
classes.description: TypedDict for real-time input data to the model.

classes.name: StartOfSpeechSensitivityEnum
classes.description: Literal type for start of speech sensitivity options.

classes.name: EndOfSpeechSensitivityEnum
classes.description: Literal type for end of speech sensitivity options.

classes.name: AutomaticActivityDetection
classes.description: TypedDict for automatic activity detection settings.

classes.name: BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInputConfig
classes.description: TypedDict for real-time input configuration.

classes.name: BidiGenerateContentSetup
classes.description: TypedDict for setup configuration of real-time content generation.

classes.name: GeminiImageGenerationInstance
classes.description: TypedDict for image generation request instance data.

classes.name: GeminiImageGenerationParameters
classes.description: Pydantic model for parameters of Gemini image generation request.

classes.name: GeminiImageGenerationRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for complete Gemini image generation request.

classes.name: GeminiGeneratedImage
classes.description: TypedDict for individual generated images.

classes.name: GeminiImageGenerationPrediction
classes.description: TypedDict for prediction containing generated images.

classes.name: GeminiImageGenerationResponse
classes.description: TypedDict for the response from Gemini image generation API.

classes.name: GeminiVideoGenerationInstance
classes.description: TypedDict for video generation request instance data.

classes.name: GeminiVideoGenerationParameters
classes.description: Pydantic model for parameters of Gemini video generation request.

classes.name: GeminiVideoGenerationRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for complete Gemini video generation request.

classes.name: GeminiVideoUri
classes.description: Pydantic model for video URI in generated samples.

classes.name: GeminiGeneratedVideoSample
classes.description: Pydantic model for individual generated video sample.

classes.name: GeminiGenerateVideoResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model for response containing generated video samples.

classes.name: GeminiOperationResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model for operation response after video generation.

classes.name: GeminiOperationMetadata
classes.description: Pydantic model for metadata of long-running operations.

classes.name: GeminiLongRunningOperationResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model for complete long-running operation response.
